long_description:
Hello Dallas!

Immerse yourself in the vibrant and intricate world of traditional attire and accessories from the rich cultures of South Asia. This ZN Fashions exhibition will showcase a stunning array of colors, fabrics, and designs that are deeply rooted in the cultural heritage of countries of South Asia.

From the elegant sarees and lehengas to the intricately designed shalwar kameez, guests will have the opportunity to buy and admire the craftsmanship that is truly unique.

The exquisite jewelry on display, including jhumkas, teekas, and bangles, will add a touch of sparkle and tradition to the overall experience. It's a fantastic opportunity to explore and shop for some of the most beautiful fashions of South Asian in one captivating event.

This fantastic Exhibition will be on:

November 15th

It will take place in:

Crystal Banquet

6300 Independence Pkwy, Plano, TX 75023

From:

11am to 7pm

*** FREE ADMISSION AND FREE PARKING ***

For stall booking register yourself at www.znfashions.com/register

For exhibition information, call at 630-776-9407 or send email to aXNyYXIgfCB6bmZhc2hpb25zICEgY29t.
